headline: Sri Lanka stocks close down 0.80-pct after rate hike
summary: Sri Lankan stocks closed down 0.80 percent after the rate hike. Interest rates were a factor in the decline, though banking counters fell less than expected.
why: The Colombo bourse reflects investor sentiment on Sri Lanka's economy, where interest rate moves affect banks and corporate borrowing costs.
why_moved: The stock market declined after the central bank raised its policy rate, which was cited as a factor behind the fall.
